claims.text: Clotrimazole troche dissolved in the mouth 4 to 5 times a day for 14 days
claims.quote: Oral candidiasis can be treated by dissolving a clotrimazole troche in the mouth 4 to 5 times a day for 14 days.
Another option is nystatin oral suspension.

claims.text: A systemic antifungal (eg, PO fluconazole) may also be used
claims.quote: A systemic antifungal may also be used (eg, oral fluconazole).
